nameJa: ライト・エクステンデッド
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: 幅広の細身サンセリフと広い余白。赤いYouTube、濃紺の見出し、小さなチャット記号を同じグリッドに揃えた文字中心の案。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE exceptionally refined type-led Chrome Web Store promotional artwork, landscape11:7 target1760x1120, full bleed. The product is YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen: watch video fullscreen with chat overlaid inside the same video. This is an abstract brand poster, not a screenshot.
Art direction10: extended-square modernism. A carefully art-directed editorial identity with a soft porcelain background, very deep navy typography, and a single vermilion-red accent. Typography is the main design: beautifully drawn extended square sans-serif with softly squared counters, medium-to-regular weight, optically balanced spacing, a little architectural character. Think custom boutique foundry wordmark precision, not default bold Arial, not futuristic videogame letters. Never extra-bold, black weight, ultra condensed or inflated. The rectangular construction of the letters quietly echoes a video screen. Flat ink only, crisp edges, no physical material effect. Use large controlled negative space and exact baseline alignments. Place the two main phrases as a broad elegant two-line lockup across the left and middle, with no collisions. Make the type around half the image height in total, allowing generous leading. Brand YouTube sits above in a smaller humanist sans, still comfortably legible. In the lower-right an exceptionally spare fullscreen video frame with four squared corners and one small vermilion chat rectangle INSIDE the frame adds meaning. Its chat consists only of two precise strokes; no fake messages. It should be an integrated brand system, not a random icon pasted alongside a heading.
Text VERBATIM each once and ONLY these three strings: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Titlecase as shown, do not convert to all caps; Fullscreen is one unbroken word F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n. All three terms should read comfortably at a final220x140 size; the YouTube label must have at least70px cap-height in a1572px-wide source. Keep every letter at least8% from the outer canvas edges. Beautiful kerning: especially Fullscreen's ll/s/c/r/e pairs and the C/h/a/t in Live Chat. No tiny captions, extra tagline, slogan, numbering or watermark. No mockup border, no magazine photograph, no people/scenery, no 3D, no shadow/bevel, no shiny glass, no plastic, no paper texture, no neon glow, no generic AI blobs. This is a finished sophisticated typographic image, not a type-specimen sheet and not a collage.

revisions.prompt: Make a typography-only design correction to this exact promotional tile, keeping its11:7 landscape canvas, ivory/navy/red palette, spare video/chat symbol, and the exact three texts YouTube, Fullscreen, Live Chat each once. Change both large headline lines to a TRUE LIGHT EXTENDED GEOMETRIC GROTESK, weight300: stems must be only ONE THIRD of their present thickness. Large airy counters, softly squared curves, very low stroke weight, elegant boutique architectural wordmark rather than bold advertising. This is a substantial letterform-weight change, not simply spacing. Visually the type should feel closer to an elegantly thin Neue Haas Grotesk Display Light / Eurostile Light drawn for an exhibition identity; no heavy parts. Reduce headline size by about15%, place all letters at least8% inside the left and right edges; increase leading. Set YouTube in the SAME LIGHT weight and around half its present size, still easily readable at220px-wide thumbnail. Use deliberate optical kerning and slightly airy tracking, premium typographic craft. Preserve Fullscreen unbroken on one line, Live Chat on another; do not add any other text, no italic, no black/bold weight, no extrusion, no shadow, no grain, no glow. The required result is visibly LIGHT, spacious and typographically refined, not another bold sans poster. Preserve all other visual content and do not add labels.
